name: Code Blocks
summary: Run a code block in your space and see its output inline, like a notebook cell.
description: Adds an Execute permission and a run command. A member who holds the permission can run a code block; the module executes it in slim-m's sandbox and posts the output. JavaScript first. Runs are deterministic: Math.random starts from the same seed on every run and Date.now() is frozen at 0, so do not rely on either to vary between runs.

changes: Promises and async code now finish before the output is shown.
The description says that random numbers and the clock are frozen.
Console output is kept when the script throws.
Adds console.error and the other console methods.
Asks for fewer capabilities when you install it.
First release: run JavaScript code blocks and see the output.
